Stinger Sub

Where do locals get Stinger Sub in Buffalo & Niagara?

No classic Stinger Sub spots in Buffalo & Niagara are on file yet; members can nominate one. A late-night Buffalo favorite: chopped steak and Buffalo-sauced chicken fingers on one sub roll with cheese, lettuce, tomato and blue cheese dressing. Places are voted by locals on Local Legends Map.

More from Buffalo & Niagara

Buffalo Wings

Chicken wings fried crisp and tossed in hot sauce and butter, served with blue cheese and celery.

Beef on Weck

Rare roast beef sliced thin and piled on a kummelweck roll crusted with kosher salt and caraway.

Sponge Candy

Western New York's crunchy, airy honeycomb candy, dipped in chocolate.

Sahlen's Charcoal-Broiled Hot Dogs

Western New York's hometown hot dog, made by the Buffalo meatpacker whose name is also on the Bisons' ballpark, Sahlen Field.

Buffalo-Style Pizza

A thick, pillowy crust, sweet tomato sauce and a heavy blanket of mozzarella, topped with cup-and-char pepperoni that curls into little cups and crisps at the edges in the oven..

Stuffed Banana Peppers

Locally grown banana peppers stuffed with Italian sausage, cream cheese and breadcrumbs, then baked.

Loganberry

Western New York's own fruit drink, sweet and a little tart, somewhere between berry and grape.
